rules.name: stroke_width
rules.rejects: too thick to be a paint stroke

rules.name: not_a_slab
rules.rejects: large and solid — street furniture, not a marking

rules.name: pigment_coherence
rules.rejects: colour too mixed or too dull for marking paint

rules.name: ground_band
rules.rejects: too high in frame to be on the ground

rules.name: flat_film
rules.rejects: shaded like a 3-D object, not a flat film on flat ground

note: Each rule votes to reject independently, with a measured number. A region can be rejected by several. Nothing here is learned and nothing calls a model — it is geometry and statistics over pixels.
